user.title: Select iPIXEL Device
user.description: Choose your iPIXEL Color display from the discovered devices, or select manual entry.

manual.title: Manual Setup
manual.description: Enter the Bluetooth address of your iPIXEL Color display manually.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Confirm iPIXEL Device
bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to add the iPIXEL device {name} ({address}) to Home Assistant?

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the device. Make sure the device is powered on and in range.
error.discovery_failed: Failed to discover devices. Make sure Bluetooth is enabled.
error.no_devices_found: No iPIXEL devices found. Make sure your device is powered on and in pairing mode.

abort.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the device.

init.title: iPIXEL panel settings
init.description: Some panels (e.g. the 32x32 B.K. Light sold at Action) report wrong dimensions over Bluetooth. Override them here if your display looks cropped or stretched. {note}

show_text.name: Show text
show_text.description: Scroll or display text on the panel using the device's built-in text engine.

text.name: Text
text.description: Text to display (templates supported, max 500 characters).

color.name: Text color (hex)
color.description: Foreground colour as a hex string, e.g. ffaa00.

bg_color.name: Background color (hex)
bg_color.description: Background colour as a hex string. 000000 = transparent/off.

show_emoji.name: Show emoji
show_emoji.description: Render a colour emoji full-screen on the panel (Twemoji).

show_clock.name: Show clock
show_clock.description: Switch the panel to its native clock mode (ticks on the device, no Bluetooth traffic). Use this from automations.

show_date.name: Show date
show_date.description: Show the date alongside the time.
